responses.question: What equation and graphing scope should be supported?
responses.answer: 2D Cartesian functions plus implicit, parametric, and polar equations

responses.question: Should a user be able to graph multiple equations on the same graph?

Confirm or revise the proposed interpretation: add a polished, Desmos-inspired graphing experience to the existing app; a user enters supported equation(s) and sees the graph; Playwright tests exercise equation entry and plotting. There is no attached reference image, and the Story does not require an exact visual clone. Confirm or state changes, including important visual qualities.
